Proposition
[Every Riemannian Metric is Pseudo-Riemannian]

↗ def:riemannian-metric ↗ def:pseudo-riemannian-metric

1. ch2:2.7

Every Riemannian metric is pseudo-Riemannian.

Proof

↗ def:riemannian-metric ↗ def:pseudo-riemannian-metric ↗ lem:nondegenerate-symmetric-bilinear \sketch For $v\ne 0$, positive definiteness gives $g_p(v,v)>0$. Taking $w=v$ verifies the witness condition for nondegeneracy; smoothness and symmetry are part of the Riemannian metric definition.

□
